verses.english: “There are these two acts of generosity.
Generosity with things of the flesh and generosity with the teaching.
These are the two acts of generosity.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ cāgānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammacāgo”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two acts of generosity is generosity with the teaching.”
